proceduralFindings.description: The historical test execution in verify-phase6-gatea-production-infra.mjs performed a POST to /api/v1/admin/seed using the production service token. The response was HTTP 403 Forbidden confirming seed lockdown. This request was outside the authorized GET/HEAD smoke-test scope.
proceduralFindings.resolution: The test script was refactored: production token reading and remote POST requests were completely removed. Seed rejection is now validated via read-only source configuration checks and an isolated local disposable Worker fixture.
